component.name: MRML
component.summary: Local AI assistant with native GGUF inference and workspace automation

description.p: MRML (Mitchell Renouf Machine Learning Library) is a local AI assistant and coding agent powered by its native GGUF engine and Gemma 4 models. It features rich multimodal understanding, headless browser automation with Chrome DevTools Protocol, desktop screenshot analysis, media processing, and automated workspace tools.

ul.li: Autonomous tool orchestration and multi-step turn planning
NVIDIA GPU acceleration through native CUDA kernels
Full headless Chromium browser automation (Brave/Chromium/Chrome) and web search
Desktop visual perception and GUI control
Speech synthesis (TTS) and microphone audio recording
Smart context management and auto-compaction for long tasks

description.p: Qt 6 desktop and CLI release with native CUDA inference, Chromium CDP automation, and Flatpak packaging.
